༄༅// bla ma zhi ba gsang ba 'dus pa'i gzhung rtsa ba phrin las cha lag dang bcas pa'i skor bzhugs so// ༄༅// mra m-i rba khrahra praḥtāḥ sarba t+gazhāh+yamaṃhāḥ rnañtsarākhwat+yaṭany+raḥ bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: dam chos ma lus 'dus pa'i gsung : sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'dus pa'i thugs: bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud: 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje yi: rgyud dang lung chen kun las kyang : tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs snying po yi: don rtogs 'dod na bla ma bsgrub: ces gsung bdud rtsi 'byung rgyud las: lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa bas: bla ma'i sku gcig bsgoms pa mchog: ces gsungs gsang ba 'dus pa las: rdo rje slob dpon sku nyid la: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku rnams rdzogs: bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos: de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun nyid: bla ma dpal chen he ru ka: kun byed rgyal po bla ma yin: ces gsungs mkha' 'gro las rgyud las: nad gdon zhi byed sman gyi mchog: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che: thams cad dbang du sdud byed cing : 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol ba'i gru: phrin las mnga' bdag bla ma mchod: ces gsungs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las: bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi rje: rgyal ba'i man ngag gsang chen rnams: ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa bsgom: zhes gsungs dgongs pa 'dus pa las: bskal pa 'bum gyi sangs rgyas pas: bla ma gnyan par shes par bya: ci phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams: bla ma dag la brten te bsgrubs: ces gsungs drwa ba sdom pa las: mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te: bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam: de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i: ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur: zhes gsungs 'jam dpal sgyu drwa las: bkur 'os brjed par bya ba'i mchog: rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os: phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab: 'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bgrod: ces gsungs sangs rgyas 'dus pa las:

gang gis gdul bya'i yid bzhin du: bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs brtsams te: de nyid don du su gnyer ba: theg chen bla ma'i sa non te: kun gyi bdag nyid chen por 'gyur: ces gsungs bla ma sgrub pa'i lung : bsam mi khyab kyi rjes 'brangs te: 'gro rnams ma lus bsgral slad du: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: gdul bya'i blo dang gang 'tshams par: bla ma'i sgrub lugs dpag med brtsams: gdul bya smin cing grol bar byas: bye brag tu yang o rgyan nga'i: rnam thar sku gsum gsang mtshan brgyad: thun mong grags pa'i mtshan brgyad la: brten nas sgrub lugs dpag med brtsams: ma 'ongs skal ldan drang ba'i phyir: gter kha du mar sbas nas bzhag: khyad par thugs gter yang gter du: sku gsum sbyar ba'i sgrub lugs la: las tshogs man ngag tshang bar sbas: sgrub chen gsang ba yongs rdzogs bzhugs: zab mo thugs kyi sgrub pa dang : nges don gsang ba bla med dang : snying tig tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang : thems yig med pa'i skor la sogs: sna res kyang ni gang zag re'i: cha rkyen rdzogs par bstan pa yin: 'on kyang kun gyi mthar thug pa: thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa yin: yang gter nang gi snying tig 'di: rtag tu gsang zhing yid la brnag: las 'phro can gyi srog yin pas: kun la mi spel gsang la bsgrub: dngos grub the tshom med par thob: byin rlabs the tshom med par 'byung : rtogs pa the tshom med par 'char: 'bras bu the tshom med par brnyes: sgrub pa lung gi byang bu'o: ༈ rgyalpargyawathar+huny+yaḥ kun gyi bdag nyid bla ma la: dang po nyid du phyag 'tshal lo: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa bstan: de la spyi sdom rnam bzhi ste: sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug don dang : sgrub pa'i man ngag lhan thabs so: thog mar sbyor ba'i chos drug ste: rten mchod bsham dang mtshams kyang bcad: sdig pa bshags shing bla ma mchod: gsol ba gdab cing dbang skur zhu:

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i chos drug la: sku bskyed sgrub pa'i snying po bzla: phrin las sgrub cing dgongs pa bskyang : rtags dbyung dngos grub blang ba'o: gsum pa rjes kyi chos drug la: dag snang bskyed cing bstod pa 'bul: nyams chag bskang zhing las tshogs bsgrub: grub mtha' gzung zhing smon lam gdab: bzhi pa man ngag chos drug ste: las byang le brgyad zab rgya brgyad: zin tig gnad brgyad gces pa brgyad: mkha' 'gro'i las brgyad dpe chung brgyad: de ltar mdo bzhi skabs rtsa bzhi: phra mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyis: thugs sgrub gsang 'dus tho byang rdzogs: rgya: rgya: rgya: gu h+ya: ༈ t+yakhapamaṅgal: gu ru pad+ma badz+ra dha ra ma hā na mo: o rgyan pad+ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa 'di la spyi don bzhis bstan te: sbyor ba dang : dngos gzhi dang : rjes dang : sgrub pa'i man ngag lhan thabs bstan pa'o: thog mar sbyor ba la don drug ste: sgrub pa'i rten mchod bsham pa dang : mtshams bcad pa dang : sdig pa bshags pa dang : bla ma mchod pa dang : gsol ba gdab pa dang : dbang skur zhu ba'o: dang por rten mchod bsham pa ni: dur khrod g.ya' gangs dben gnas su: dkyil 'khor stegs bu thar byas te: bdud rtsi lngas byug dpe chung ltar: legs bris dbus su bum pa'i nang : a mṛ ta dang mngar gsum sbyar: ril bu lha grangs mnyam par brub: dar dmar mgul chings gzungs thag gdags: kha rgyan shug pa rma bya'i sgro: de steng mañdzi khri'u steng : mtshan ldan dum gcig 'brus bkang ba'i: steng du o rgyan tsa ka li: bskyed rim lta bur bris pa la: khong du byang sems sin+dhūr: 'o mar sbyar te sngags 'di bri: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma: badz+ra gu ru thod phreng rtsal: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma rā dza: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa: badz+ra gu ru shākya seng ge: badz+ra gu ru sūr+ya 'od zer: badz+ra gu ru siṃ ha sgra sgrogs: badz+ra gu ru blo ldan mchog sred:

badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro lod: badz+ra gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta: sarba bha ga wān: sarba dhe ba: sarba hrīḥm ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya: dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ a: zhes bri rten 'brel snying po bri: bla mar bskyed bstim yang yang bya: rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs su: bsams te mnga' gsol rab gnas bya: dar dmar gur phub dar sna lnga'i: 'phan dang rgyal mtshan zur bzhir gzugs: mdun du mtshan ldan ka pā lar: gtor ma 'bru lnga'i zan la bya: pad+ma 'dab brgyad zur bzhi'i gseb: dbus su ri rab steng rin chen: 'bar ba gcig la rin chen brgyad: lcags ri rin chen nyer brgyad bskor: nyi zla ri rab shar nub brgyan: lag len dpe chung lta bu la: sha mar zas sna bdud rtsis bran: g.yas su bdud rtsi g.yon rak+ta: bshams te mtha' ma tshogs kyis bskor: phyi nang mchod pa ci 'byor bsham: thod rnga ḍa ti rkang gling dril: rin chen maṇ+ḍal rgyan ldan bsham: rang gi yid 'ong rgyan bkram mo: gnyis pa mtshams bcad rim pa ni: rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal bas: hūm̐: nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang : bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa bshags pa bya ba ni: thal sbyar gnong 'gyod sems kyis su: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: khyed ni rnam dag dri ma med: bdag ni nyon mongs sgrib pas bsgribs: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya: sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3ho: sarba dharma sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: bzhi pa bla ma mchod pa ni: 'dzin chags med pa'i yid dang pas: maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bcu gcig pa'i: steng du rin chen brdar byas la: ri rab gling bzhi 'dod yon lngas: gang bar bsams te yang yang dbul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐:

de nas rang gi yul 'khor nor: rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul: de nas rang mdun mi mgo yi: sgyed bu rnam pa gsum btsugs te: rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: rang gi thod pa bregs te gzugs: de nas rang lus bses te grub: sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsams te: de yang snying po 'di bcu bsam: de steng rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas: rtse lnga oṃ dkar brgyan par bsam: 'og tu yi ge yam̐ ram̐ las: me rlung 'bar bas rlangs phyung ste: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing du spros: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te: rdo rje la thim rdo rje yis: lan gsum dkrugs pas bdud rtsir 'khyil: rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: ka pā las bcus bla ma mchod: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mchod: lhag mas rigs drug gdon bgegs rnams: lan chags 'khor nas mnyes par bsam: rgyas par las byang le brgyad ltar: bla ma mchod la brtson par bya: lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni: pho brang dbus kyi rten de nyid: rang gi re ltos gyur pa yi: bla mar gyur pa thams cad dang : dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: kun gyi ngo bor gyur pa la: rnam pa sku der gsal bsgom te: de yang gdos bcas ma yin par: gsal la rang bzhin rtog pa med: bla ma dngos su dag snang bskyed: gdung ba drag bskyed mchi ma dbyung : de nas gsol ba 'di skad gdab: kye kye bla ma rin po che: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zung : bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig po: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: sdug bsngal 'dam nas drang du gsol: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khyod la bdag nyid bran du 'bul: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzod: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun:

'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig: oṃ ཿāḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma rgyal po sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha ba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru blo ldan mchog sred sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru nyi ma 'od zer sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru shākya seng ge sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru seng ge sgra sgrogs sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro lod sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sarba ḍā ki nī sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: drug pa dbang bskur zhu ba ni: bla ma yab yum gnyis med pa'i: spyi gtsug oṃ la mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ la lte bar hrī: yum gyi lte bar ma bsgom mo: de nas yab yum spyi gtsug nas: oṃ dkar 'od zer dang bcas pa: bdag gi smin mtshams mdzod spur babs: bum dbang thob nas lus sgrib dag: sku yi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas yab yum mgrin pa nas: āḥdamar 'od zer dang bcas pa: bdag gi lce yi dbang por babs: gsang dbang thob nas ngag sgrib dag: gsung gi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas yab yum thugs ka nas: hūm̐ mthing 'od zer dang bcas pa: bdag gi snying gi dkyil du babs: ye shes dbang thob yid sgrib dag: thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas yab yum lte ba nas: hrīḥm 'od zer lnga bcas pa: bdag gi lte ba'i dkyil du babs: tha mal sgo gsum 'dzin sgrib dag: dbyer med lhan skyes dbang bzhi thob: bdag bde sems can kun bder bsam: de nas dbang don bsam bya ste: lus ni rnam snang chos bdun bca': yid ni gsang lam mig 'bras kyi:

dkyil du ma yengs tsen ne bzhag: blo yis mi bcos dran med du: skyes bu khong snying phyung ba ltar: bdag 'dzin med par so le bzhag: bsgom bya sgom byed med par zhog: rang byung ye shes lhan skyes 'char: der gsal chos nyid rol pa la: der 'dzin skyes na 'ching bar byed: de nyid rang rig mi 'gyur na: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob nas: nyon mongs skyes tshad grogs su 'char: bdag nyid chen po bla ma yi: dbang chen thob nas nges shes skye: dngos gzhi bla ma sgrub pa la'ang drug: sku bskyed pa'i rim pa dang : snying po bzla ba dang : phrin las sgrub pa dang : dgongs pa bskyang ba dang : rtags dbyung ba dang : dngos grub blang ba'o: thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa ni: oṃ chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje sems: pad+ma'i rgyal po 'di skad smra: dang por chos rnams dmigs med pas: smra bsam brjod bral rdzogs pa che: blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: blo bral de yi ngang nyid las: sems can kun la khyab pa yi: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can des: 'gro don dpag med byed pa la: rang nyid gser gyi rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje'i 'od las gzhal yas khang : pad+ma rin chen 'bar ba spel: 'ja' tshon bris pa lta bu'i nang : lte dbus nyi zla pad steng du: rdo rje gnas gyur dran rdzogs kyis: rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyi bo'i gtsug: rta mgrin rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: phyag g.yas dbang sdud gri gug bsnams: phyag g.yon thod khrag bdud rtsi gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs bdud bzhi brdzis: nyi zla pad steng 'gying zhing brjid: g.yon nas rdo rje phag mos 'khyud: cha lugs yab 'dra spyi bo'i gtsug: phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrogs: gzhon tshul nu ma bha ga rgyas: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs:

'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: de nyid spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng : pad+ma ge sar snying po la: bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs su: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: de yi 'phang g.yon rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon tshul can: pad mdog nu ma bha ga rgyas: rin chen rus rgyan cod pan can: phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: phyag g.yon thod pa'i bdud rtsi stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked nas 'khril: sku mdog dkar la 'dzum mdangs can: skra grol gcer bu mdangs ldan bsam: 'khor yug 'ja' yi drwa bar bsgom: rin chen zur brgyad 'dzum dag la: spros la dga' na mtshan brgyad sku: so so'i sgrub thabs bzhin du bskyed: pho brang phyogs bzhir pad 'dab bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen 'bru'i: nang khongs zhing gi gdan bzhi la: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: sku mdog rigs kyi kha dog la: 'khril sbyor rgyan dang cha lugs rnams: dbang chen yab yum ji bzhin no: sna tshogs pad kor phyi ma la: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin dang : chos skyong rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dngos grub ster zhing bar chad sel: glu len gar byed rol mo sgrogs: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs stob: char sprin 'thibs pa lta bur bsam: du mar snang yang rang du gcig: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: rang dang lhan cig skyes pa la: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med pas: spyan drang bzhugs gsol 'dir mi dgos: rang las byung zhing rang dbang bsgyur: rang sems bla ma lha ru snang : dbang dang rab tu gnas pa ci: 'dod pa'i yon tan mang po yang :

rang sems ye shes rol pa'i rgyan: rang las sprul zhing rang mchod pas: mchod rdzas gzhan gyis bskang mi 'tshal: snang srid gzhal yas lha bla ma: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par gnas: 'dzin pas mi 'ching gsal bar bsgom: tsa ka li ni sku yi rten: de ltar blta zhing dmigs pa bzung : ma yengs yid kyi 'dzin phur thob: bla ma lha yi srog thob nas: sku ni gsal bar ston par gyur: bskyed rim gzer gyis ma thebs na: bskal par sku ni mthong mi 'gyur: de phyir bskyed rim legs gnas bya: gnyis pa bzlas brjod rim pa ni: dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dbang dang mtshungs: yang yang skyor ba man ngag yin: zab mo thugs kyi snying po 'di: gdung ba'i shugs phyung drag tu bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de bzlas snang srid g.yo bar 'gyur: dus gsum rgyal ba dus gcig sdud: bla ma kun dang 'du 'bral med: 'byung po dregs pa brgyal zhing 'bros: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin ltar 'du: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ sham bu'i sngags 'di btags gyur na: dpa' bo pho tshogs mo tshogs rnams: rang dbang med par mngon du 'ong : bdag la lung ston legs nyes smra: bstod cing gsol 'debs bsgo ba nyan: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud: mkha' 'gro chos skyong bran ltar 'du: bsam pa kun 'grub the tshom med: rten 'brel la sogs kun 'grub gyur: gsum pa phrin las dmigs pa ni: bsnyen sgrub gang la drod thob nas: phrin las sgrub pa'i 'phro 'du ni: bdag nyid chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer dkar po hūm̐ 'phros pas: zhi ba'i las byed thod phreng rtsal: cha lugs rang dang mtshungs pa la: yum med sku mdog dkar la 'tsher: zhi tshul na bza' dar dkar gyon: rdo rje lcags kyu ḍa ru thogs: rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:

skye 'gro'i nad gdon dgra dang bgegs: sdug bsngal zhi bar byed par 'gyur: bdag nyid chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ser po swā 'phros pas: rgyas pa'i las byed thod phreng rtsal: cha lugs rang dang mtshungs pa la: yum med sku mdog ser la 'tsher: rgyas tshul na bza' dar ser gyon: rin chen zhags pa ḍa ru thogs: rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: skye 'gro'i tshe dang bsod nams dang : longs spyod dbang thang rgyas byed bsam: bdag nyid chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer dmar po ām̐ 'phros pas: dbang gi las mdzad thod phreng rtsal: cha lugs rang dang mtshungs pa la: yum med sku mdog dmar la 'tsher: dbang gi rang bzhin dar dmar gsol: pad sdong lcags sgrog ḍa ru thogs: pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: khams gsum srid gsum dbang bsdus nas: bde ba'i sa la 'god par bsam: bdag nyid chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ljang gu hā 'phros pas: drag po'i las byed thod phreng rtsal: cha lugs rang dang mtshungs pa la: yum med sku mdog ljang la 'tsher: mngon spyod na bza' ljang gu gsol: rgya gram dril bu ḍa ru thogs: las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: bstan pa'i bar chad tshar bcad nas: bla med gnas su sgrol bar bsam: bdag nyid chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer sna lnga oṃ 'phros pas: thams cad lhun grub thod phreng rtsal: cha lugs rang dang mtshungs pa la: yum med sku mdog smug la 'tsher: thams cad lhun grub dar ber gsol: 'khor lo bdud rtsi ḍa ru thogs: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: thams cad ma lus zil gyis gnon: phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsgom: 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa ma shes na: dmigs pa phyogs gcig don mi 'grub: 'di bzhin phrin las sbyor shes na: gang ltar bsams pa de ltar 'grub: dper na yid bzhin nor bu 'dra: rgyas par las tshogs bzhin du 'grub: bzhi pa dgongs pa bskyang ba ni: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams:

logs na yod pa ma yin no: ye nas bdag med gzhal yas khang : 'khor bas ma gos pad+mar gsal: dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin po che: kun gzhi'i klong yangs phag mo yum: yid kyi byed pa rta mgrin yab: mi skye mi 'gag chos kyi sku: ye nas bdag med spros dang bral: bla ma rang rig kun tu bzang : bde chen rnam dag mtsho rgyal yum: rtog tshogs rang grol dpa' bo ste: 'gyur med thag chod mkha' 'gro ma: de ltar rang byung lhun gyis grub: rang byung lhun grub bsam yas pa: skye med chos sku'i rang rtsal yin: skye med bde chen de rtogs na: gzhi med rtsa bral lhan skyes 'char: 'khor ba ma spangs 'khor skyon dag: pad+ma 'byung gnas rang la rdzogs: gnyen pos mi shigs 'gyur ba med: rdo rje sems dpa' rang la rdzogs: de ltar dgongs na kun tu bzang : 'di ltar ma dgongs bla ma nyid: mtshan bcas dngos su grub 'dod cing : lung ston dngos su re ba na: thun mong phran tshegs grub srid kyang : thar pa'i gegs byed don dang 'gal: 'di ltar dgongs na 'dre bsgrubs kyang : bla ma chos kyi sku dang mjal: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung : lnga pa grub rtags 'byung tshul ni: thun mong du ni 'di ltar 'byung : bdag lus bde ba'i dngos grub 'byung : lus kyi rdzu 'phrul ston par nus: ḍā ki dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags: bud med rigs gyur kun kyang 'du: dpa' bo dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags: sngags btsun skye bo thams cad 'du: dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang 'dus rtags: rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma yang : rmi lam tsam du mkha' 'gro rnams: lung ston chos 'chad legs nyes smra: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du: rigs gang dbang du 'dus pa'i sar: gdul bya rgya mtsho ma lus 'byung : ngag la nus pa thogs med 'byung : ma bslabs chos sgo smra bar nus: dmod pa btsan zhing smon lam 'grub: yid la dag snang dpag med 'char: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i gnas chen mthong :

mngon par shes pa phra mo 'byung: khyad par rtags su bla ma yi: dag snang dpag med 'char ba dang : chos sgo dpag med gsung ba dang : yang na snang ba bla mar 'char: snang srid kun gyi chos rnams ston: dngos su bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub: 'on kyang dam la gnas pa gces: drug pa dngos grub blang ba ni: khyad par can gyi rtags mthong ngam: 'dzab bsnyen bye ba thems kyang rung : dus bsnyen zhag grangs thems kyang rung : dus la babs par gyur pa na: bum pa nyid la gzhal yas bskyed: ril bu rtsa ba gsum du bskyed: kun gyi sku gsung thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i dngos grub bsdus: bum pa'i nang du bdud rtsir 'khyil: rtsa ba gsum yang 'od du zhu: dkar dmar 'od de gzungs thag la: 'khril nas bdag nyid snying gar 'dus: dngos grub thams cad thob bsam zhing : bsnyen sgrub sngags sham 'di btags bzla: ka ya wāk+tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ wa shaṃ karma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sid+dhi pha la sarba hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ dpal zan spos dang bdud rtsis bran: rin chen zhi rgyas dbang drag bya: 'bru lnga mtshon te sngags bsnyen dbul: spro dga' dang bcas rol bar bya: tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang po bya: des ni mchog dang thun mong gi: dngos grub kun 'byung the tshom med: sgrub pa rjes kyi las la'ang drug: dag snang bskyed pa dang : bstod pa bya ba dang : las tshogs sgrub pa dang : grub mtha' bzung ba dang : smon lam gdab pa'o: dang po dag snang bskyed pa ni: sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rgyud dag las: rtsa ba'i bla ma 'dren pa'i gtso: sems can sangs rgyas mnyam par sbyor: 'di la ma dag log lta na: shes bya kun la ma rmongs kyang : ngan song gsum las 'phag mi srid: de skad gsungs pas rtsa ba yi: bla ma gtsor mchod bla ma yi: spyod lam kun la dag snang bsgom: gal te mi dge sdig spyod kyang : rang gi ma dag snang ba yin: dper na mig skyon can gyis ni:

gangs nyid ser por mthong dang mtshungs: log rtog can gyis chu nyid la: rnag khrag mtshon char mthong dang mtshungs: de phyir bla ma'i rnam thar la: log lta skyes na thar lam 'gag: de phyir blo bcos dag snang bskyed: dag snang skyes na bdud rtsi yis: thar lam mchog la sbyor ba yod: log lta skyes na bdud rtsi yis: kun gyi 'chi bdud byed par nges: de phyir bla ma'i rnam thar rnams: brda' dang chos su shes par gyis: bla ni 'gag pa med pa'i don: ma ni skye ba med pa'i don: skye 'gag gnyis med rang dag pa'i: snang ba 'di la yang dag gnas: 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi: bla ma'i rnam thar thams cad ni: 'gro 'dul chos nyid rol pa yin: rtog

bdog pa zer ba'ang snang : pa thams cad yongs btang la: sgyu lus bla ma'i bran du dbul: gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes: gang du yang ni mi rnyed de: bla ma'i dus thabs brten pas 'grub: gnyis pa bla ma'i bstod pa ni: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin du: nges shes bskyed la 'di skad do: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las byon bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid tshangs pa'i dbyangs: thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: mngon spyod las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: thams cad lhun grub bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod: yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la bstod: shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i: blo ldan mchog sred sku la bstod: khams gsum ma lus dbang bsdud pa'i: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la bstod: dregs pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: rdo rje gro lod sku la bstod: rmongs pa'i mun pa sel mdzad pa'i: nyi ma 'od zer sku la bstod: log 'dren bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa'i: shākya seng ge'i sku la bstod: mu stegs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa'i: seng ge sgra sgrogs sku la bstod: snang ba ma 'gags thugs rje chen po'i sku:

rta mgrin dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong : rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las: thugs rje ma 'gags cir yang sprul cing ston: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas don dang mthun par bstod do: gsum pa nyams chags bskang ba ni: spyi gtsug pad+ma'i gdan steng du: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' che: sku mdog shel 'dra'i thugs ka nas: zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs: bdag gi nyams chags sgrib bsal bar: bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa bzla: oṃ badz+ra gu ru sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra gu ru twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān: badz+ra gu ru mā me muñtsa: badz+ra gu ru bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ brgya'am nyer gcig bdun bzlas pas: nyams chags thams cad skong bar 'gyur: de rjes kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i: ngang la yid ni dran med bzhag: nyams chags rang byung rang dag bzhag: nyams chags skong ba'i mthar thug go: bzhi pa las tshogs sgrub pa ni: thugs rje chen po thod phreng rtsal: gang la gang 'dul der bstan nas: yid bzhin re ba bskang ba'i phyir: gsang mtshan brgyad du bsgrub pa ni: man ngag bkol bar shes par bya'o: lnga pa grub mtha' bzung ba ni: thugs sgrub 'di bzhin su bsgrubs pa: thun mong nyid thob mchog la reg: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa: dus 'di nyid du lhun gyis grub: rab 'byams bka' yi dbang yang thob: sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las bdag nyid 'grub: sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can: 'di yi grub pa'i mthar bzung ngo : drug pa smon lam gdab pa ni:

e ma hoḥ bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: bskal pa dpag med tshun chad nas: tha ma da ltar thug gi bar: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bla ma skyes mchog yi dam lha: sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bsgoms bsgrubs mchod cing bstod pa dang : bris bklags bcangs shing kun chub bgyis: lta sgom la sogs dge spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur cig: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi: bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs shing : dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i: 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun: bla ma mchog gis bzung nas kyang : yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa de 'grub pa'i: don grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga la: phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog: rang dang bla ma gnyis med pa'i: dgongs pas sgrub rdzas tshogs la rol: dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya'o: bla ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba mthar thug don gyi mchog rdzogs so: s-i mi y-i tha graṃ: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: mi smra rgya: mi bstan rgya: tsit+ta'i dkyil du zungs: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: bka' rgya: 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// skal ldan mos pa'i gang zag rnams// o rgyan nyid kyi zhal mthong nas// rig 'dzin sa la bgrod par shog/ ༈ /gsang 'dus bla ma'i las byang snying po rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+mā ka rā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rnam rol tu// mngon par 'char ba'i khyab bdag thod phreng rtsal// rang rig bla ma'i ngo bor nges pas 'dud/ bla med dngos grub kun gyi 'byung ba'i sgo// pad+ma'i thugs gter zab lam snying po'i bcud// gsang 'dus rtsa ba'i gzhung dang kha skong khrigs// rnam dag gzhung don ji bzhin 'dir gsal bya// de'ang gsang 'dus rtsa ba'i sgrub gzhung las/

gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa bstan: de la spyi sdom rnam bzhi ste: sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug don dang : sgrub pa'i man ngag lhan thabs so: thog mar sbyor ba'i chos drug ste: rten mchod bsham zhing mtshams kyang bcad: sdig pa bshags shing bla ma mchod: gsol ba gdab cing dbang bskur zhu: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i chos drug la: sku bskyed sgrub pa'i snying po bzla: phrin las sgrub cing dgongs pa bskyang : rtags byung dngos grub blang ba'o: gsum pa rjes kyi chos drug la: dag snang bskyed cing bstod pa 'bul: nyams chag bskang zhing las tshogs bsgrub: grub mtha' gzung zhing smon lam gdab: bzhi pa man ngag chos drug ste: las byang le brgyad zab rgya brgyad: zin tig gnad brgyad gces pa brgyad: mkha' 'gro'i las brgyad dpe chung brgyad: de ltar mdo bzhi skabs rtsa bzhi: phra mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyis: thugs sgrub gsang 'dus cha rkyen rdzogs: zhes gsungs pa las/ skabs 'dir rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum po'i khongs su/ rang gzhung tshugs shing kun gyi kha skong ba/ zhes pa'i brgyad tshan drug gi dang po las byang le'u brgyad pa nyid gseb tshags su bsdeb shes par bya ba la/ dang po rten mchod bsham pa ni/ gzhi'i bdag po la gtor ma 'bul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la bdud rtsi lngas byugs shing*/ hūm̐/ bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i chag chag gdab: byung dang 'byung gyur dkyil 'khor mchog: ye shes lnga rdzogs gzhal yas gsal: oṃ sarba pañtsa gu h+ya dzñā na maṇ+ḍa la trām̐: zhes khyems med par byas la/ bdag dang slob ma gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang las spros pa'i byang chub sems kyis thig gdab pa dang tshon gyi cho gas dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa 'bri ba'am/ maṇ+ḍal bdud rtsis byugs pa lha grangs kyi tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung ngo*// rten rdzas dbus su bum pa bcud ldan gyi steng du mañdzi'i khar thod pa dum gcig 'brus bkang ba'i dbus su dam tshig gi bris sku dgod/

steng nas dar dmar po'i gur phub/ de'i mdun du gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba sha mar zas sna dang bdud rtsis bran pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman dang rak+ta/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi nyer spyod sogs mchod par 'os pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bsham zhing*/ sgrub mchod dkyus ma tsam la sgrub rten gtor ma la byas kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mgrin yum dang bcas pa'i skur bskyed la/ bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lag gnyis mkha' lding gi rgya ston bzhin par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi mthar/ ha ho hrīḥzhes dang*/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba bhū ta ā kar+ṣa ya dza/ zhes mgron dgug oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes rdor thal phye bas lan gsum du bsngos te/ hūm̐/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐/ nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang : bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas rdo rje khro bo srung ba'i gur gyis khyab par bsam mo// gsum pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ pho brang dbus kyi rten de nyid: rang gi re ltos bla ma dang : dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: kun gyi ngo bor gyur pa la: rnam pa bla ma rdo rje sems: gsang 'dus rgyal ba'i sku ru gyur:

zhes bshags yul du gsungs pa nyid la rten bcas te: na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas su: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca' 'o: zhes lan gsum dang*/ bshags pa dngos ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: khyed ni rnam dag dri ma med: bdag ni nyon mongs sgrib pas bsgribs: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya sarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ: sarba dharmāḥs ma ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes bshags pa bya'o// bzhi pa bla ma mchod pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bcu gcig bkod pa ri rab gling bzhi dang 'dod yon lngar dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hāḥ zhes dang*/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang : dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams: kun bzang mchod sprin cher spel nas: bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: ces dang*/ spro na ku sā li'i tshogs gsog kyang bya'o// lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye kye bla ma rin po che: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' che: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig po: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: sdug bsngal 'dam nas drang du gsol: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzod: bdag la dbang skur byin rlobs la: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun: 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes ci nus bzla'o// drug pa dbang skur zhu ba ni/ bla ma yab yum sku yi gnas bzhi nas: 'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas bzhir thim: sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis: byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur: zhes dbang don la dgongs pa bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug gi/ dang po la sku bskyed pa dngos dang*/ de dang rjes su 'brel pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ oṃ/ chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje sems: pad+ma rgyal po 'di skad smra: dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing : smra brjod bral ba rdzogs pa che: blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: āḥ blo bral de yi ngang nyid las: sems can kun la khyab pa yi: brtse ba'i snying rje chen por bsgom: hūm̐/ stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nyid las: 'gro don dpag med byed pa'i slad: rang rigs gser gyi rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje'i 'od las gzhal yas khang : pad+ma rin chen 'bar ba spel: 'ja' tshon bres pa lta bu'i nang : lte dbus nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : rdo rje gnas gyur dran rdzogs su: rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu yi gtsug: rta mgo rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: phyag g.yas dbang sdud gri gug 'phyar: phyag g.yon thod pa khrag bkang gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs bdud bzhi brdzis: nyi zla pad steng 'gying zhing brjid: g.yon nas rdo rje phag mos 'khyud: cha lugs yab 'dra'i spyi bo'i gtsug: phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrogs: gzhon tshul nu ma bha ga rgyas: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: de nyid spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng : pad+ma ge sar snying po la: bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs can: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa:

gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: de yi 'phang g.yon rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon tshul can: pad mdog nu ma bha ga rgyas: rin chen rus rgyan cod pan can: phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: phyag g.yon thod pa'i bdud rtsi stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: sku mdog dkar dmar 'dzum mdangs can: skra grol gcer bu 'od ldan bsam: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i thod phreng rtsal: dkar ser dmar dang ljang gu'i mdog: las bzhi bsgrub phyir mos pas bskyed: khor yug 'ja' yi drwa bar bsgom: phyogs mtshams rin chen zur brgyad kyi: 'dzum steng bar snang 'ja' 'od klong : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad gsal: hrīḥ pho brang phyogs bzhir pad 'dab bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen 'bru'i: nang khongs zhing gi gdan bzhi la: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: sku mdog rigs kyi kha dog la: 'khril sbyor rgyan dang cha lugs rnams: gtso bo yab yum gnyis ltar bskyed: sna tshogs pad 'khor phyi ma la: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin dang : rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: dngos grub ster zhing bar chad sel: glu dang gar byed rol mo sgrogs: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs stob: char sprin gtibs pa lta bur bskyed: du mar snang yang rang du gcig: ces pa ltar bsgoms nas dzab bzlas la zhugs kyang rung bar gsungs so// gnyis pa rjes 'brel ni/ lhan thabs le brgyad kyi le'u gsum pa dang bzhi pa sbyar ba ste/ dang po la gsum gyi spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor:

khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyi rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: yon tan sna tshogs dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma saṃ bha zhes su grags: byin gyis rlob= rā ga rak+ta'i gnas mchog tu: thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub brnyes: blo ldan mchog sred ces su grags: byin gyis rlob= dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma rgyal po zhes su grags: byin gyis rlob= so sa gling gi dur khrod du: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: nyi ma 'od zer zhes su grags: byin gyis rlob= za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su: bdud 'dul drag po'i dngos grub brnyes: shākya seng ge zhes su grags: byin gyis rlob= ma ga dhā yi grong khyer du: mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: seng ge sgra sgrogs zhes su grags: byin gyis rlob= stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub tu: dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: rdo rje gro lod ces su grags: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐/ yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling : zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo ru: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: grub pa mthar phyin dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hrīḥ bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas nas: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: bdud 'dul ging bzhi gshegs su gsol: dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas:

mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ma lus dang : rig 'dzin chos skyong thams cad byon: dbu la thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: sil snyan mang po si li li: rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: rol mo mang po di ri ri: dpa' bos bro brdung khrabs se khrab: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs ya la la: mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thibs se thib: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong sgra si li li: lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra: g.yas nas pho rgyud thibs se thib: g.yon nas mo rgyud thibs se thib: dpal gyi ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i bshugs pa kyu ru ru: dpa' mo'i gar byed shigs se shig: hūm̐ gi snang glu di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang : byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin byon par bsam mo// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ rin chen pho brang nyams re dga': dur khrod gzhal yas byin re che: pad+ma 'dab bzhi mdangs re gsal: rtog med ro ldan bag re dro: nyi zla brtsegs pa 'od re gsal: bzhugs pa'i gnas su dwangs re spro: gu ru yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgyes shing byin gyis rlob phyir bzhugs: mos pa'i bu la zhal bstan 'tshal: gsung gi gdams pa'i gnad bsgrag 'tshal: thugs kyi dgongs pa'i sgo dbye 'tshal: 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes pas dgyes shing gnyis med du bzhugs par bsam mo// phyag 'tshal ba ni/

e ma ho: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: spros bral kun bzang bde chen mo: rdo rje sman gcig mtsho rgyal yum: bde stong gnyis med thabs shes sbyor: yab yum gnyis med phyag 'tshal lo: bya byed yid chos rnam par dag: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams 'dul: dbang chen rta mchog yab yum la: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal lo: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rol: chos srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: pra tīts+tsha hoḥzhes phyag bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa la/ byin brlab dang 'bul ba gnyis las/ dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe sarba dharmāḥswa bha wa bi shu d+dho3haṃ: mchod rdzas thams cad stong par sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod pas rgya cher spel/ bhan+dha gzhal yas khang nang du: bcud ni rigs lnga yab yum ste: sbyor mtshams byang sems bdud rtsir zhu: 'ching grol med pa'i rang bzhin gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: zhes lan bdun bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ rak+ta byang sems dmar por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti ma hā pañtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ zhes pas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab bo// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul bar spyi dang bye brag khyad par gyi mchod pa dang gsum las/ dang po spyir mchod pa las/

phyi mchod ni/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan yid 'ong rnams: spyan shangs thugs ka sku lus dang : zhal dang snyan du mchod par 'bul: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ nang mchod ni/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod: gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: gnyis su med par thim gyur cig: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: gsang mchod ni/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las: byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i mchog: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod par 'bul: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa bye brag tu mchod pa las/ sman mchod ni/ oṃ/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: dug lnga sel phyir ye shes lnga rdzogs rdzas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes dang*/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: longs sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal du= sprul sku rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zhal du= mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal= 'gro mgon mnga' bdag yab sras zhal= chos bdag gter ston chos dbang zhal= rgyal sras mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal= dwags ston dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhal=

gnyen ston ye shes rdo rje'i zhal= se sdings sangs rgyas yab sras zhal= gu ru chos sku 'od zer zhal= mtshungs med dpal 'byor dbang phyug zhal= sprul sku chos kyi dbang po'i zhal= rig 'dzin karma gu ru'i zhal= grub chen kun bzang dpal 'byor zhal= rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub zhal= drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal= yi dam rta phag yab yum zhal= rigs lnga mkha' 'gro yab yum zhal= ma mgon dam can gter srung zhal= mchod par 'os pa rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan dag mos blo bzhin spros pas chog go /rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ āḥ 'dod chags rnam dag pad+ma rak+ta 'di: rgyud drug kun sgrol khams gsum dbang du sdud: bde mchog bde spyod rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā rak+ta khā hi: gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rje btsun bla ma gshegs su gsol: gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs shing : 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: ba liṃ rgyan gyi= sman rag bdud rtsi'i= zhal zas tshogs kyi= ting 'dzin rtse gcig mchod pa 'bul: bla ma rig 'dzin mchod pa bzhes: yi dam lha tshogs mchod= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams= ging gi tshogs rnams= dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams= dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang : mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dwangs re spro: dur khrod gnas mchog nyams re dga': zhing chen bla re rgyan dang ldan: sha sna snying sna bsam mi khyab: spro dga' gnas kyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐/ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gying ba 'di: ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs re mtho: ma mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba 'di: gling bzhi gling phran bas kyang bkod re legs: dkar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub pa: gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che:

rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng ba 'di: rgya mtsho mching rnam bas kyang rgya re che: bdud rtsi sman gyis gtor mar sbran pa 'di: lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro re bda': dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang : dri chu byug pa'i rdzas te rnam pa lnga: seng ge glang chen rta dang ba lang dang : mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lnga: ma hā māṃ sa la sogs sha sna stong : ma hā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong : dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang : ba su ta dang nang khrol rnam pa lnga: shing tog me tog 'bru sna sman sna stong : zan dang khur pa thug pa'i bye brag dang : mar thud phrum dang zho dang 'o mar bcas: rtsi dang tsa ru rtsi chen go snyod dang : lga dang lan tshwa spod kyi bye brag dang : ri sgog klung sgog shwa mo sna tshogs dang : bza' dang bca' ba btung ba'i bye brag dang : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs kun: thogs med blo yis thams cad kun bsdus nas: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs te: bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gtor ma chen po 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam skong gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam= mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i= dpa' bo ging bzhi'i= dam can srung ma'i= mchod par 'os pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes 'bul te lhan thabs kyi le'u bdun pa nas 'brel bsdebs pa'o/

/'dir gtor bsngo gtong*/ mchan/ gsum pa khyad par tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams par bdud rtsis bran la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas bsangs la/ hūm̐/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro: ram̐/ ram̐ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yam̐/ yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: kham̐/ kham̐ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: hūm̐/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin gyis rlob pa'i yi ge spros: hūm̐/ hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: āḥ āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: oṃḥ oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang : hrīḥ hrīḥyis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlab bo// de nas las kyi rdo rjes tshogs rdzas rnams slob dpon la phyogs pas bzung ste/ hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom byar mi rung : bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: zhes drang*/ slob dpon gyis pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ rin thang med las legs 'ongs chos: 'dod chags dri ma rnam par dag: gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i: de bzhin nyid ni bdag kyang 'tshal: zhes brjod cing blang ngo*// de ltar rtog pa bsal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ tshogs phud cha gsum du bcad pa'i dang pos mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: zhes mchod/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig bdag lus ngag sems kyis: rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ zhes pas bshags/ tha ma bsgral bstab bya ba ni/ tshogs zan nam gzugs brnyan la dmigs bya bstims la/

phur pa yak+ṣa kro dhar gsal bas gzir zhing*/ hūm̐/ che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon pas phur bus dgra snying gzir: gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ nṛ tri sha trūn dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa a yaṃ rbad: ces tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas bsgral la/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi: bhin+dha ya bhin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces sha khrag bdud rtsir sbar la bstab bo// rtsa ba'i gnyis pa sgrub pa'i snying po bzla ba la dzab dgongs dang*/ rjes 'brel skong ba gnyis la/ dang po ni/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: zhes pa'i dgongs pa srog tu bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la sems rtse gcig pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du cung zad bzla'o// dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar bla ma rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thod phreng rtsal gyi sku'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal la sems rtse gcig pas kyang bzla ste/ sha med 'od kyi gzugs can ni: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku ru bsgom: zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa ste sgrub pa'i tshul lo// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs bzhi'i thod phreng bskul bas de las rang 'dra'i sprul pa dang 'od zer mkha' khyab tu spros pas phrin las rnam bzhi gang 'dod pa de sgrub par bsams la/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya rbad: ces pa rnams cung zad re bzla ste las sbyor gyi tshul lo// gnyis pa rjes 'brel skong ba la rdzas kyis sku la skong ba ni/

mchod rdzas su gyur tshad bshams shing*/ khyad par mar me dang bdud rtsi thogs nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba'o// bshags tshig gis gsung la skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang : sgrub rdzas gnyen po gzhung bzhin bkram lags na: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam gnyen bskangs te: rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sol stsol cig: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ zhes lan gsum bskyar zhing skong bshags kyi rim pa gzhan yang bya'o// lta bas thugs la skong ba ni/ kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangs nas: rang rig rang gsal kun tu bzang : gdod nas ma skyes kun bzang mo: gnyis med bde ba chen po la: bskang dang bshags bya bshags pa'i yul: rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku: chos kyi sku la gnyis su med: gnyis med rtogs pas thugs dam bskang : de ltar rtogs na skong bshags mchog: ces bskang ngo*// rtsa ba'i gsum pa spyi tsam ni/ gong du thod phreng rigs lnga bskyed pa dang*/ las sbyor gyi bzlas pa nyid kyis tshang zhing*/ khyad par ni snyan brgyud zhag bdun ma'i zhal shes sbyor ba'o// rtsa ba'i bzhi pa dgongs pa bskyang ba ni/ 'di ltar kun rdzob tu snang ba'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad don dam chos nyid lha dang gzhal yas khang du ye nas rdzogs pa'i gnas lugs ji bzhin pa nyid spros med du bskyang zhing mthar bogs dbyung ba'i gsol 'debs kyang bya'o// rtsa ba'i lnga pa ni rtags tshad kyi drod 'dzin pa'o// rtsa ba'i drug pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ mdun gyi sgrub rdzas la dmigs nas gsang sngags sham bu can cung zad bzlas pas sa khongs gzung ngo*// spyi don gsum pa rjes la drug gi dang po dag snang bskyed pa ni/ bla ma nyid skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bzod med mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos dag snang skyed pa nyid do// gnyis pa bstod pa 'bul ba la sngon du mchod pa/

bstod bskul dngos/ mtha' rgyas gzhan sbyar ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gtor sman rak+ta mchod par gsungs pa bzhin/ hūm̐/ dam rdzas gtor chen bshams pa yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: bdud rtsi sman mchod sbreng ba yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro= bhan+dha rak+tas bkang ba yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro= dur khrod rdzas chen bkram pa yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro= rkang gling thod rnga sgrogs pa yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro= zhun chen snang gsal gtams pa yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro= māṃ sa'i gsur dud gtong ba yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro= 'dod yon ro mchog spungs pa yang : ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: thugs dam gnyen po skong gyur cig: g.yar dam nyams chags sor stsol cig: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hoḥ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di dag kun: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du 'bul lags na: blang dor med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang : thim pa'i tshul gyis dgyes pa chen por rol: zhes 'bul lo// gnyis pa ni hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' sgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: dbang gis las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: thams cad lhun grub bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hrīḥ ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod: yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la bstod: shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i: blo ldan mchog sred sku la bstod: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la bstod: rmongs pa'i mun sel 'gro ba 'dul: nyi ma 'od zer sku la bstod: log 'dren bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa'i: shākya seng ge'i sku la bstod: mu stegs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa'i: seng ge sgra sgrogs sku la bstod: dregs pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: rdo rje gro lod sku la bstod: hrīḥ snang ba ma 'gag thugs rje chen po'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong : rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las: thugs rje mi 'gag cir yang ston cing sgyur: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam can srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ ma g.yel ma g.yel rig 'dzin tshogs: ma g.yel ma g.yel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma g.yel ma g.yel ging gi tshogs: ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can tshogs: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rang bzhin gnas nas sku skyod la: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: ging gi tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: dpa' bo'i tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: dpa' mo'i tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: dam can tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: chos kyi dbyings nas sku skyod la: rdo rje phag mos byin gyis rlobs: dur khrod gnas nas sku skyod la: mkha' 'gro ging bzhis byin gyis rlobs: nam mkha'i dbyings nas sku skyod la: rdo rje phra min byin gyis rlobs: rgya mtsho'i gling nas sku skyod la: mtsho gling mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas sku skyod la: las byed mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs:

gangs dkar rtse nas sku skyod la: rdo rje ging chen byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hūm̐: lho nub rnga yab gling phran na: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : gnas mchog dam pa nyams re dga': gnas mchog nyams su mi dga' ru: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: skye 'chi med pa'i skur bzhengs nas: srin po rnams la dam chos ston: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor: ging chen sde bzhi bran du 'khol: lha srin sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul: dbu la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sil snyan mang po si li li: rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru: rol mo mang po di ri ri: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag so so yi: phrin las myur du khyed kyis sgrubs: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyod kyis sgrol: sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs: dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis bstod: rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis thul: lha 'dre mi gsum khyed kyis sdus: 'byung bzhi'i bar chad khyed kyis sol: dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod: gsum pa mtha' rgyas gzhan sbyor ba ste/ tshogs rdzas rnams/ hoḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyun du rol: a la la ho: zhes slob dpon nas bzung 'dus pa thams cad la brim zhing nang gi sbyin sreg gis rol lo// de nas lhag ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la dam tshig gi kha phru btab pas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/

dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: pad+ma he ru ka phud kyi bdag: bar du lhag mas mi mchod du: ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes: tha ma gcig tu mi bsre ru: gnyis med chos sku gcig las byung : hūm̐/ bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka: yum chen rdo rje phag mo la: bka' yi lhag sdud tshogs kyis bskor: lhag ma'i tshogs la rol pa rnams: 'dir byon bka' yi lhag gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phyi rol tu dor ro// chad tho bya ba ni/ chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs gtor gral las bskyed de byin brlabs bsngos nas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la: 'og min gnas mchog bde chen pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru kas: rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags nas ma mo btul: tha tshig gsum gyis dam la btags pa'i tshe: rdo rje phag mo la sogs mkha' 'gro bye ba brgyas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : yal gam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: brag dmar bsam yas ār+ya pa gling du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : shes rab yum chen mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis: dbang chen yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: dur khrod gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang: dregs pa sde brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: so so'i gzugs= yal gam can= bka' yi gtor= bcol pa'i phrin= sngon tshe zhal= sha khrag brgyan= thugs dam rgyud= de 'og bskal pa tha ma'i dus kyi tshe: rnga yab gling phran zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang : rig 'dzin chos dbang laṅka'i tshogs bcas kyis: gsang ba sgrub chen dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe:

bse lang mkha' 'gro bka' sdod sgrol ging bzhi: dam can rgya mtsho chos skyong srung ma yis: so so'i gzugs= yal gam can/ bka' yi gtor= bcol pa'i phrin= sngon tshe zhal= sha khrag brgyan= thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma gtsang sar phul la/ bshal chus brtan ma bskyang ba ni/ brtan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring : dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gseng thang kun bzang shān+ti dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis gtor ma longs: mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zlog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta khā hi: ma ma hriṃ ma ma hriṃ khā hi khā hi: zhes brtan ma bskyangs la rta bro ni/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og dgra bgegs bkug cing mnan par bsams la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rta yi brtul zhugs chen po ni: bdag nyid chen po'i skur bsgoms te: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phung po la: gtum chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrogs shing : dbang chen rta skad tse re re: khro bo'i bro rdung 'u ru ru: dpal gyi rta skad di ri ri: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: gsang ba'i bshugs pa kyu ru ru: bskal pa'i glog dmar ljibs se ljib: rdo rje'i thog 'bebs lams se lam: hūm̐ gi dbang bsgyur khams gsum g.yo: phaṭa kyi sprul pas 'jig rten khyab: ram̐ gyi me 'bar thams cad sreg: gcan gzan mu kha sprin ltar gtibs: kaṅka 'dab chags skar ltar 'khrug: sngon gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings su: khams gsum yongs sgrol mdzad pa'i tshe: za byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung po la: gcan gzan chen po'i bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i zhe sdang bcom: khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba la: ma tshogs ḍā ki'i bro brdungs pas: kun tu zhen pa'i 'dod chags bcom:

rngams chen 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gti mug sha chen spungs pa la: sder chags 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: rmongs pa'i gti mug ngo bo bcom: gtum chen khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dbang po yan lag rdzogs pa la: gshog pa rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: kun tu rmongs pa'i phrag dog bcom: 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: dbus kyi khri rkang zlum po la: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdungs pas: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal bcom: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: dug gsum 'joms pa'i las byas pas: sngon gyi dam tshig chen po skong : ma tshogs ḍā ki'i dkyil 'khor du: stan gaṇa sprul pa'i las byas pas: rnal 'byor skong ba'i cho ga rdzogs: dbang chen gar gyi dkyil 'khor du: bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i las byas pas: khams gsum bsgral ba'i cho ga rdzogs: phyag brnyan chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: bka' 'das bsgral ba'i las byas pas: ru dra mnan pa'i cho ga rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bro brdung ngo*// skabs 'ga' zhig tu gtor dbang byed na gnad kyi shog gcig mar gsungs pa bzhin bskur ro// dngos grub len pa ni/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba la mchod cing bstod nas dzab kyis thugs dam bskul te/ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas thugs dam can: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng gi: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub mchog: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal: bum pa bzang po dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol: 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'gag med gsung gi= 'khrul med thugs kyi= yon tan re skong= phrin las 'gro 'dul= 'chi med tshe yi= 'dzad med nor gyi= thun mong yid bzhin= bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol:

rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pas gtor ma'i ye shes pa bdag la bstim/ dam tshig pa 'dod yon bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams la gtor zan dngos grub kyi rdzas su rol lo// dbang bskur gtso bor byed na tshogs la rol pa'i sngon du byed pa phyag len no// rtsa ba'i gsum pa nyams chags bskang ba ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo la rten bcas te yi ge brgya pa ci nus brjod pas bzod par gsol te/ nyer bsdu ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid: dgyes pa chen pos rang la thim: rang yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i: ngang la yid ni 'dzin pa bral: rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku: zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad spyi bo'i bla ma la 'dus shing*/ de nyid rang la bstims nas gnyis med spros bral blo 'das kyi dgongs pa bskyang ngo*// rtsa ba'i bzhi pa las tshogs sgrub pa ni mtshan brgyad sgrub pa'i man ngag bkol byang bzhin shes par bya'o// rtsa ba'i lnga pa grub mtha' gzung ba ni/ lam 'di kho na dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa bar nges pa'i gdeng bca' ba nyid do// rtsa ba'i drug pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ e ma hoḥ bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: bskal pa dpag med tshun chad nas: tha ma da ltar thug gi bar: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bla ma skyes mchog yi dam lha: sangs rgyas byang sems ḍā ki'i tshogs: bsgoms bsgrubs mchod cing bstod pa dang : bris bklags bcangs shing kun chub bgyis: lta dgongs la sogs dge spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur nas: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi: bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs shing : dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i: 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa: bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: ces pa dang*/ rjes 'brel shis pa brjod pa ni/

shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don 'grub pa'i: don grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga nas: phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog: ces sogs shis pa rgya cher brjod pas dge legs su bya'o// de ltar mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog /mchog gi myur lam bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs// thabs tshul kun gyi snying po rmad byung 'di// 'di phyir bde legs 'dod pa rnams kyis bsten// o rgyan bla ma'i thugs sgrub kun gyi phul// gsang 'dus rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs gzhung nyid dang*// lhan thabs le brgyad skabs don 'brel chags pa// gyer sgom bklags chog 'jug bde'i khrigs su bsdebs// sngon byon mkhas dang grub pa dam pa sogs// du mas rgyas bsdus rnam pa mang mdzad mod// 'on kyang rang blos phyogs mthong brjod pa'i mtha'// bkag pa med phyir lhag bsam dag pas so// 'di las bsod nams dge ba'i dngos po gang*// thob pa de yang mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams// srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i zung 'jug lam// o rgyan bla ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang snying po rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ gsang 'dus sgrub pa'i gzhung nyid rtsa bar bzung*/ kha skong le brgyad dang skabs babs kyi 'brel bsdebs nas gyer sgom chog sgrigs la 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te o rgyan smin grol gling rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sder tshes bcu'i mchod pa spros bcas kyi phyag bzhes can btsugs pa'i tshe snyom las pa 'gyur med rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge sbyong blo gsal rgya mtsho dang o rgyan dpal 'byor te rnam pa gnyis kyis so// ༈ /na maḥpad+ma badz+rā ya: gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*// srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam grol ba'i// bde chen mchog stsol thod phreng rtsal// kun 'dus rgyal ba de la 'dud// 'dir thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa las khyad par thod phreng rtsal rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar dbang bskur ba'i tshul la gsum ste/
sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom dang*/ dngos gzhi sgrub thabs dang*/ dbang gi cho ga'o// dang po yo byad kyi gshom ni/ rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal bcas pa'am/

byin gyis brlabs pa'i thig tshon gyis dkyil 'khor lte ba mthing ga ze'u 'bru ljang gu pad 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog rin chen zur brgyad mthing ga gzhi dmar ser phyi skor pad 'dab bcu drug rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pas so// stegs bu khebs ldan me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du bum pa bcud ldan/ de'i khar bdud rtsi'i thod pa me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le lha grangs can rtsa sngags bris pas bkab pa dang*/ de'i steng du gtor ma sku 'bag dbang gi skabs 'di dang lha bskyed bcas sgrub dus ltar bya/ dang bcas pa'ang bkod/ mi bde na gtor ma mdun du bzhag de dag gi g.yas g.yon tu sman dang rak+ta/ nyer spyod lnga sogs mchod pas mtha' bskor/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad kyang tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub thabs las sngon 'gro ni/ bgegs gtor btang ba ni/ byin brlabs nas sngags kyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan tu dengs: hūm̐/ nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang : bgegs 'dul khro ba'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru de ba ḍā ki nī badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bka' bsgos la mtshams bcad/ skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don tu: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas su: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca'o: zhes pa'i rjes su mchod rdzas byin rlabs gsang 'dus las byang bzhin nam/ yang na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsregs sbyangs bkrus/

snying ga nas āḥyig gsum 'phros sman gtor rak+ta'i gnas su ka pā la gsum du gyur pa'i nang du oṃ gsum 'phros pa las sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i phung po dang rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho rnams su gyur/ hūm̐ 'phros pas mgron rnams 'dus par bsams la 'bru gsum mang du brjod par bya'o// dngos gzhi las lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral las// kun khyab brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom// rang rig rdo rje hrīḥbacas gsal// rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang*// pad+ma rin chen 'od 'bar dbus// ti ra nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*// bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// dbu gtsug rta zhal phag gdong mtshan// g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag bsnams// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor tshul// dur khrod rol pa'i chas rnams rdzogs// spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng*// rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// ā tsar gzhon tshul dkar dmar zhal// mthing nag za ber chos gos dmar// pad zhwa sgro dar me long mtshan// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon bhan+dha// snyan cha mgur chu kha ṭ+wām̐ 'dzin// skyil krung gzi brjid 'od 'bar bsam// phyogs bzhir pad 'dab mkha' 'gro ging*// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las// rigs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan 'dzin// brkyang bskum dur khrod chas rdzogs bsam// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs// bsam gyis mi khyab yongs rdzogs gtibs// sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs la// ye shes lnga yi dbang rdzogs shog /yang sgrub dus kyi dbang du ni/ ā tsar zhes pa nas/ 'od 'bar bsam/ zhes pa'i bar gyi rkang pa drug gi dod du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs can// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can// phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin// phyag g.yon dril bu dku la brten// pad mdog ye shes mkha' 'gro yum// bdud rtsi stob pa g.yon nas 'khril// zhes bsgyur ro// spyan 'dren pa na/ི

hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// zhes sogs nas/ oṃ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ zhes tshig bdun mas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med du bya'o// mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng gshegs su gsol// gdung ba drag pos bdag gsol 'debs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa 'bul// ba l̥ṃ gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// ting 'dzin rtse gcig mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ hoḥ dam rdzas mchog gi mchod pa 'di dag kun// gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang*// thim pa'i tshul gyis dgyes pa chen por rol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza me gha khā hi: zhes mchod/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag 'gyur med sku gsung thugs dang ldan// rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams bsgral slad du// phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i re ba skong*// pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'am ma bcos spros bral ma gang bde bya'o// dzab bzla ba ni/ bla ma'i gnas bzhir oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥrnams gsal ba las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi bo nas zhugs spyi mgrin snying lte rnams su dbang bzhi thob/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong ba la sems rtse gcig pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bla ma rang la bstims nas sku'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal brtan pos kyang sngar bzhin bzla'o// gsum pa rjes la tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ gsang 'dus las byang sogs ris mthun gyi cho ga gang 'os nas blang zhing gnam skas klu bdud sogs gter srung mchod pa'ang bya'o// dngos grub blang ba ni/

gu ru'i gnas gsum nas dngos grub 'od zer gyi rnam pas sgrub rdzas la bstims te rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs bzlas nas/ oṃ/ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas thugs dam can// badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng gi// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub stsol// ces dngos grub blang zhing rdzas la rol/ gtor ma btang*/ dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus nas 'od gsal du bcug bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gsum pa byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni zlum po bzhi dbang du grags pa ste/ sbyor ba yo byad bsham pa ni sngar ltar las maṇ+ḍal me tog sogs khyad par gyi rdzas rnams tshogs par bsham/ sgrub tshul bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgoms la bzlas pa yan chad sngar ltar byas nas/ bum pa gzhal yas khang du bum bcud gu ru yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems bdud rtsir 'khyil bar bsams la rtsa sngags mthar ba sham ku ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥzhes btags pa gzungs thag la brten nas ci rigs pa bzla/ gter srung la gtor ma 'bul/ tshogs mchod ni 'di'am dbang gi mtha' gang 'os su bya/ 'og gi slob ma'i bya ba rnams bdag 'jug ting nge 'dzin dbang bskur gyi tshul du len pa'am rig pa'i me tog dor ba gang 'os bya'o// dngos gzhi slob ma'i bya ba ni/ gnas khang gi sgor khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang nas mtshams bcad/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu rnams byas la slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi byin rlabs dbang bskur ba zab mo zhu snyam pa'i mos pa brtan pos ma yengs par gsan par zhu/ de yang rang cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/

gdul bya rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'god par mdzad pa'i thabs kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bstan pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni lam zab mo bla ma sgrub pa nyid yin te/ dgongs 'dus las/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas pa// bla ma gnyan par shes par bya// ci phyir zhe na bskal pa yi// sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kun// bla ma dag la brten nas byung*// zhes dang*/ he badz+ra las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar dngos grub thabs cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni bla ma sgrub pa nyid yin la/ de nyid sgrub pa'i sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa las/ khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas kun bzang chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas longs spyod rdzogs sku snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa las zhing 'dir gdul bya'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don du sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul mtha' yas par snang bar mdzad cing*/ khyad par rgya gar dang o rgyan bod yul la sogs par thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la ston pa nyid dang rnam dbyer med pa'i phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'khor ba ji srid bar bzhugs nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i don lhun grub tu mdzad pa'i gu ru rin po che de nyid la/ las can rje 'bangs rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas zab rgyas kyi gdams pa khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig stsal ba snyigs dus kyi gdul bya skal ldan rnams kyi don du gter kha du mar sbas pa las/ 'di ni gter ston chen po chos kyi dbang phyug gis lho brag gnam skas brag nas spyan drangs pa bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor te/

de yang gter ston nyid nas sras slob brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa drin can bla ma dam pa'i bar rim par brgyud pa dang*/ rdor gling zab gter gyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor yang bla ma nyid kyis gsan pa 'di dang tshig don mtshungs pa'i phyir chu bo gcig 'dres su'ang 'gyur zhing*/ gang ltar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa de rnams kyis thugs nyams su bstar ba las mchog gi sa la bzhugs pa sha stag bar ma chad du byon pa lags/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ bka' rtsis las/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs mos gus ches mang gi// rang dang dbyer med bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs// de gang zhe na bla ma gsang 'dus skor// mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs// zhes dang*/ nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub// nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong*// nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir gter kha 'di la bla ma sgrub pa'i bka' babs shing khyad par du 'phags par gsungs pa'i mtshan gzhi yang bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor 'di nyid yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa thod phreng rtsal sgos sgrub dang 'brel ba zlum po bzhi'i dbang bskur du grags pa ste/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*// gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la// brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i// bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na// dkyil 'khor kun gyi snying po mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob// ces gsungs pa ltar sgrub par byed pa yin la/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song*/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ tsak+ṣurban+dha bā ra ma ṇā ya swā hās mig dar bcing*/ phyag len bsdus pa'i skabs mig dar 'ching grol dang me tog gtad 'bul mi mdzad/

āḥkhaṃ wī ras me tog gtad la/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba gu ru thod phreng rtsal gyi dbang dang byin rlabs la 'jug pas rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dag par byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ khams gsum 'khor ba las dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ gzengs bstod pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon du dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas skyabs sems dang sdom pa bzung ba ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang mtha' skor du yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs par bsams la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// sogs lan gsum/ de nas rtsa ba'i dam tshig bzung zhes pa ni sdom bzung ste dam tshig dang sdom pa'ang ldog pas dbye ba tsam ste don du bsgrub bya spong ba dang dgag bya sgrub pa gnyis 'gog pa'i sems pa ni sdom pa dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bslab pa'i mtha' las mi 'da' ba ni dam tshig yin pas/ de'i don du sngar gyi skyabs yul rnams kyi spyan sngar tshig phyir sems rtse gcig pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas// kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum mo// byang chub ma thob bar du ni// skyabs kyi mchog tu gzung bar bgyi// sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags// 'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya snyam// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing*// sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir// 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de// gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad// don dam spros bral byang chub sems// rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal sgom// zhes lan gsum/

de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung nas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ snying gar sems gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum dwangs gsal 'od kyi sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar g.yung drung dmar po'i lte bar zla ba la yam̐ dang yan lag bzhi la ha ri ni sas mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon gyis yam̐ zhes brjod pas slob ma'i snying ga'i yam̐ bskul rlung g.yos g.yung drung du g.yon du shugs drag por 'khor ba la sems gtad/ de'i tshe ye shes pa sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa can 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar ba kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa gyis zhes brda sbyar la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥzhes btags pa bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas pas byin phab/ des ma phebs na slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐/ bzhengs shig rje btsun pad+ma bzhengs// dgongs shig bla ma slob dpon dgongs// rig 'dzin gnas nas sku bskyod la// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bzhengs shig yi dam lha tshogs bzhengs// dgongs shig rgyal ba rigs lnga'i tshogs// chos kyi dbyings nas sku bskyod la// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bzhengs shig ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhengs// dgongs shig ḍā ki sde lnga'i tshogs// dur khrod gnas nas sku bskyod la// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rgyas par/
oṃḥ sku yis byin gyis rlob tu gsol// sogs kyang brjod cing*/
