nyang gter phag mo zhal gnyis ma ltar/ byi la nag po'i brun/ pad+ma rak+ta/ sha chen/ gu gul/ klad pa/ bdud rtsi lnga/ rang gi skra rnams bsregs pa'i dud pas bdug cing rol mo'i sgra yun ring bya'o// de'i tshe sku phebs na 'phar g.yo/ gsung phebs na smra rgod/ thugs phebs na brjod med kyi rtogs pa skye zhing*/ nyams thod rgal du 'bar na de nyid skyong du bcug tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas me tog 'bul du bcug la rigs ngos bzung*/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes me tog slob ma'i mgo bor bcing*/ oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces mig dar bsal/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bstan la lha ngo sprad/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol// ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams// bla ma'i rjes gnang dbang thob nas// sangs rgyas sa la gshegs pa ltar// de rjes bdag kyang 'jug par 'tshal// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la me tog 'thor/ de nas dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ 'di ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin yang gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod rnams rim pa bzhin dbang bzhi'i bdag nyid can du bskur ba la rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin la/ de la dang po bum pas dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dbyer ma mchis pas 'di ltar dbang rnams rim pa bzhin bskur ba las spang bya'i dri ma rnams dag cing thob bya'i yon tan thams cad thob par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bum pa spros bral zlum po na// skye med byang chub sems kyi chus// rnam rtog ma rig dri ma bkru// chos sku spros bral bde chen chus// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i bag chags bkru// rang byung ye shes sems nyid chus// dug lnga dug gsum dri ma bkru// nyon mongs bag chags kun byang nas// dbang bzhi'i ye shes rdzogs par shog

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥgu ru de ba ḍā ki nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥzhes lan gsum brjod/ dang po spyi bor bzhag nas khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ gnyis pas mgrin par gtad nas bum chu blud pa gsang dbang*/ snying gar gtad nas tshig don sprad pa ni/ sems nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral bar mtshon pa'i bum ba zlum po/ skye med rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed chus bkang ste dbang bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas dag par shes pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ des bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ thod pa spyi bor bzhag la/ āḥ thod pa zlum po chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang*// 'chi med bdud rtsi chang gis rab tu bkang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga ye shes lnga// nyon mongs bdud 'joms rigs lnga sku lngar bskyed// gnyis med ngang du chos nyid rol par sbyor// ma bcos rang byung bde chen byang chub sems// chos nyid bdud rtsi rnam rtog bdud las rgyal// dbang bzhi'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod la/ dang po thod pa spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ gnyis pas mgrin par gtad nas bdud rtsi blud pa gsang dbang*/ snying gar gtad nas tshig don ngo sprad pa ni/ sems chos dbyings thig le nyag gcig mtshon pa'i thod pa zlum po'i nang du/ gzhi nyon mongs lnga ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lngar rang rig pa sku lnga'i bdag nyid 'chi med kyi go 'phang brnyes pa mtshon byed bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas/ mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dag par shes pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ des bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// gsum pa me long gi dbang ni/ hūm̐/ me long zlum po chos dbyings dri ma med// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med par dwangs// gzugs brnyan gsal la ngos bzung 'dzin pa bral// sems nyid rnam dag gsal la mi rtog 'gag

/gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i dngos po'i yul las 'das// byang chub sems kyi cho 'phrul cir yang snang*// gsal stong ma 'gags dbyings nas gsal 'grib med// dbang bzhi'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /rtsa sngags brjod pas spyi bor bzhag mgrin par 'jog pa dang mnyam du slob dpon gyi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba thon pa zhal gyi sgo nas slob ma'i khar zhugs snying gi sa bon la thim par bsgom du bcug nas sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byas la/ me long spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gtad nas sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag nas rig pa gsal la ma 'gags par gtad pa ni/ sems nyid chos sku dri ma med pa mtshon byed me long g.ya' dag zlum po la/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu dang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid kyi gzugs brnyan cir yang shar ba mtshon byed tshom bu sngags bcas kyis brgyan pas dbang bskur bas gsal ba la stong pas rgyas thebs par shes pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ sems bde gsal la mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// bzhi pa gtor ma'i dbang ni/ hrīḥ gtor snod bhan+dha gzhal yas chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma ye shes rnam lnga 'dod yon lnga// gu ru'i sku mchog bde chen 'du 'bral med// rnam dag bdud rtsi bla ma mchod pa'i rdzas// gnyis med dbyings su dam tshig gnyan po bsre// ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul slad du// sprul pa mang po las la 'gyed pa'i phyir// dbang bzhi'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i sa thob shog /sngags brjod bzhin du gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gtad nas gtor zan myang pa gsang dbang*/ snying gar gtad de tshig don ngo sprad pa ni/ sems nyid chos kyi dbyings ris su ma chad pa mtshon pa'i gtor snod bhañdza zlum po'i nang du/ gang shar thams cad bde chen du rang rig pa gu ru'i sku dang 'dod yon rnam lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin tu rnam par dag pa bdud rtsi'i mchod rdzas dbyer med du mtshon pa gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/

sems nyid snang stong zung 'jug tu rtogs pas 'khor 'das gnyis med kyi dbyings su dam tshig gnyan po 'dres pas phyi nang gi ma mo ḍā ki dbang du 'dus te phrin las bzhis 'gro ba ma lus pa 'dul ba'i phyir du sprul pa yang sprul las la bkye bar shes pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ des bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// lnga pa sku 'bag gi dbang bskur ba ni/ sku spyi bor bzhag la/ aḥ chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku gsal la ma 'dres gu ru'i sku// sprul sku sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul// sku gsum ngang du mnyam nyid ma 'dres gsal// sngon tshe pad 'byung khyed dang smon lam gcig /da lta bdag dang slob ma'i stangs zung zhig /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub lags so// ye shes dbang chen rab 'byams bskur rdzogs shog /rtsa sngags brjod pas spyi bor bzhag mgrin par 'jog pa dang mnyam du me tog phog pa'i rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang ming 'dogs te badz+ra gu ru rtsal zhes pas mtshon no// de ltar sku spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag ste gsang mtshan btags pa ni gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag ste bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du ngo sprad pa ni/ sems nyid ye thog ma nas sku bzhi lhun grub tu gnas pa'i gu ru rdo rje thod phreng rtsal sku bzhi dbyer med mtshon pa gu ru'i sku'i dbang bskur bas/ rang tha mal du 'dzin pa dag nas/ rang sems gdod nas dag pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang 'dra yang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pas sgo gsum tha mal du gyur pa 'di sbyong ba'i phyir bdag dang slob ma la byin gyis rlob par shes pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ des bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// de ltar rtsa ba'i dbang rnam pa lnga la bzhi bzhir phye bas na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba dbang bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa'i byin rlabs thod rgal du thob par 'gyur ba yin no// des na rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig spyi dang*/

khyad par yab kyi dbang rtags su sku 'bag dang rdo rje bzung zhing bcang*/ yum gyi dbang rtags su me long dang ka pā la dum bu bzhi pa 'chang*/ yab yum gnyis su med pa'i dbang rtags su tshes bcu'i mchod pa ma chag par gyis shig ces brjod/ slob mas kyang khas blang zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// 'di'i dbang rdzas snying gar 'jog skabs tshig don ngo sprod rgyas par byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pas spro na zur du bris pa ltar bya'o/ 'di ni lo chen gsung las 'byung ba ltar dkyus su btsud do/ /mig dar 'ching 'grol sogs tshig gis dngos zin la med kyang don gyis thob pas smos so// gong du/ tshogs mchod ma btang na skabs 'dir gtong zhing*/ rjes gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ nongs bshags gshegs gsol/ nyer bsdu smon lam shis brjod rnams bya ste las byang bzhin no// gsang 'dus bla sgrub snying po'i bcud// 'gyur med bde chen lam bzang mchog /rdo rje'i gsung bzhin 'jug bder spel// skal bzang rnams kyi nyams su long*// gsang 'dus thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub dang 'brel ba zlum po bzhi dbang gi le tshan no// ༈ /bla ma gsang 'dus kyi bsnyen yig nyung gsal bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+mā ka rā ya/ 'dir bla ma gsang 'dus kyi bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i zin bris la/ thog mar rten mchod bsham pa ni/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma btang ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bur bdud rtsi lngas chag chag btab pa la/ thig tshon gyi cho ga dang ldan pas/ dbus mthing 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog rin chen zur brgyad mthing*/ pad 'dab bcu drug mdzes tshon gyi mthar dur khrod rdo rwa me ris bskor ba tsam mam/ spro na sgo rdzogs ma rdul tshon gyis bri ba'am ras bris bkram/ shin tu bsdu na lha grangs kyi tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung*/ de'i dbus su bum par chos sman dang mngar gsum gyi gzhi la sman sna btab pa 'bras phyes bsgril pa'i ril bu dmar pos sum gnyis tsam khengs par bkang la/

dar dmar gyi mgul chings/ shug pa dang rma bya'i sgros kha brgyan cing gzungs thag btags/ de'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa dum gcig nas sam 'bras kyis bkang ba'i dbus su sku rten rab gnas can btsugs/ bum pa'i mdun du ka pā lar gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'am ma 'byor na gtor zlum pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba bshams/ gzhan yang srung ma'i gtor ma/ sman rag nyer spyod sogs bkod legs par bshams zhing*/ de dang kha sprod kyi tshul du rang gi stan dang rdor dril sogs yo byad rnams tshang bar 'du bya/ spro na gur sgrom dang steng 'og gi 'khor lo sogs kyang bya dgos mod/ ku sā li'i bsnyen sgrub la 'di tsam gyis chog shes par bya/ dgong thun nas sgrub pa la 'jug ste/ sgo drung du tho brtsig bgegs gtor brlabs shing bsngos la/ rang rta mgrin du gsal ba'i sku las rang 'dra'i khro bo'i sprin spros te bgegs bskrad cing*/ de ltar spros pa'i khro bo'i tshogs kyis phyogs mtshams khyab par bcings te bsrung*/ de nas las byang ltar mdun rten bskyed/ skyabs sems sngon 'gros bshags pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal sogs kyis mchod cing bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang dbang bzhi len pa rnams byas la tshogs zhing rang la bstims nas dbang don bskyang*/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ bdag dang mdun rten dbyer med du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rta mgrin bsgoms pa'i phyogs bzhir pad 'dab la rigs bzhi yab yum/ rta mgrin gyi dbu thog tu bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ de'i mdun dang phyogs bzhir thod phreng rigs lnga/ de'i phyi rol la rin chen zur brgyad kyi thad ka'i steng gi bar snang la mtshan brgyad/ de'i mthar mos bskyed tsam gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs dang*/ pad 'dab bcu drug la yi dam lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bsgoms shing*/ de thams cad du mar snang yang rang gi sems nyid bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa'i rtsal snang tsam du thag bcad nas/

ma 'dres yongs rdzogs me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal stong zhen bral tu bsgom par bya ba gces so// de yang ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bzhugs gsol phyag mchod rnams byas rjes/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha: zhes sogs kyis snang srid snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor chu zla'am 'ja' tshon ltar snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba la 'dzin med du sems bzung ste/ spyi gtsug gi bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i spyi bo'i oṃ sogs las 'od zer spro bsdus dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa sbyar te/ bzla bya'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa kho nar thun bzhir bcad nas dus bsnyen zla ba gsum/ grangs sa ya rjes la bgrang ba'i lugs ltar bye ba gcig ste 'bum phrag bcu/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni dngos nyams rmi lam gang rung du slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i zhal mjal ba sogs so// bsnyen pa de gsum gang rung sngon du song bas las sbyor gyi bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ thod phreng rigs lnga bsgoms pa'i 'phro 'dus bzla ba'am/ khyad par snyan brgyud zhag bdun ma'i zhal shes sbyor tshul gyi gnad shes par bya'o// gang ltar yang*/ bzlas pa'i thun 'jog dus las byang bzhin du rtsa ba'i bzhi pa dgongs pa bskyang ba la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ drug pa dngos grub blang ba bsnyen pa thon khar byed pa yin mod/ 'dir sa khongs 'dzin byed tsam du sngar bshams pa'i bum pa'i gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ gsang sngags sham bu can nyer gcig tsam re bzlas rjes tshogs byed na las byang du mchod pa'i skabs su gsungs kyang bsnyen pa'i skabs su 'dir byed pa'i phyag len ltar byas la/ dkyus ltar gtor sman rak+tas mchod cing*/ bstod bskul rnams kyi mthar/ chos srung gi gtor chog rnams byas la tshogs la rol zhing*/ tshogs lhag ma bsngos nas btson du bzung*/

thun bsdu ba na/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la rten bcas te yig brgya cung zad bzlas pas bzod par gsol nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyi bo'i bla ma la 'dus/ de nyid rang la bstims nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag slar yang rta mgrin gyi skur chu las nya ldang ba ltar langs la smon lam brjod cing*/ spyod lam la 'jug go /de ltar thun bzhir bcad pa las/ tshogs dang chos srung gi gtor chog dgong thun nam srod thun gyi rjes gang rung las thun gzhan rnams la mi dgos/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang lha'i gsal snang dang ya ma bral bas sngags ci nus bzla zhing grangs la mi brtsi/ nyal dus kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la nyal/ thor thun la sngags sgras sad de thun mtshams kyi lhar langs nas thun la 'jug bza' btung ye shes kyi bdud rtsir brlabs te nang gi sbyin sreg gis rol/ de lta bus mtshan dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa gang rung thon pa dang*/ sang nangs par grol rgyu'i dgong thun nas/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bshams shing*/ thun mthar 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad bsdus te sgrub gtor dang dngos grub kyi rdzas la bstim pa'i dmigs gnad bcas pas dngos grub bsdu ba'i dzab bzla/ khyad par grol rgyu'i snga thun la bzlas pa thon rjes/ slar yang srung 'khor gsal gdab/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyi rnam par logs su bye bas dngos grub len pa byas te/ dngos grub bsdu ba'i bzlas pa sngar ltar bya/ de nas mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ bde mchog bde spyod kyis dngos grub bskul rjes rtsa sngags sham bu can bzla bzhin du sgrub gtor lhar gsal ba las byin rlabs dngos grub kyi skal ba thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te dbang bzhi blang zhing*/ sgrub rdzas rnams gnas bzhir gtugs/ mthar lha 'od du zhu ba'i gtor zan bum pa'i ril bu sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol/

de nas mjug gi bya ba tshogs lhag gtor skyong sogs byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing bsngo smon shis brjod/ tho 'grol gnas bsrung ba sogs mtha' rgyas rnams gsang ba spyi'i 'gros bzhin shes par bya'o// zhes pa'ang 'gyur med rdo rjes so// ༈ /bla ma gsang 'dus kyi bsnyen yig zur 'debs bzhugs so// na moḥpad+mā ka rā ya/ gsang 'dus bla ma'i bsnyen yig rje bla mas mdzad par/ mtshan dus grangs gsum gang rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro bas las sbyor gyi bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ thod phreng rigs lnga bsgoms pa'i 'phro 'dus bzla ba'am/ khyad par snyan brgyud zhag bdun ma'i zhal shes sbyor tshul gyis gnad shes par bya gsungs pa/ snyan brgyud zhag bdun ma'i zhal shes zur tsam ni/ le brgyad las/ bsnyen dus bla ma spyi bor bsgoms: gsol 'debs tshul du dzab 'di bzlas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phro 'du yis: dbang zhu dngos grub blang bar bya'o: zhes bsnyen pa dngos gzhi dang : sgrub dus bla ma rang gsal gdab: gsang sngags 'dus pa'i snying po bzlas: zhes pa 'dir dgongs/ de yang dus bsnyen zla ba gsum lta bu song ba'i thor srod gang rung gi thun nas 'dzugs shing*/ tshul ji ltar bya ba ni/ thun bzhi'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum sngar ltar las thod phreng rtsal gyi bzlas pa stong phrag gam brgya tsam skabs sbyar bzla ba'i ring dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du snga ma bzhin bya/ de rjes spyi bo'i bla ma rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal yab yum rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i yab kyi spyi bor kun tu bzang po mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum gyi spyi bor kun tu bzang mo gri thod bsnams pa/ yab kyi mgrin par snang ba mtha' yas dmar po mnyam bzhag gi steng bum pa bsnams pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ yum gyi mgrin par gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod/

yab yum gnyis kyi snying dbus su dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang chen po rer gyur pa'i nang yab kyi dur khrod kyi dbus su rta mgrin dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas khams gsum dbang sdud kyi rgyas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu/ ral pa'i gseb na rta mgo ljang zhur/ dur khrod kyi chas can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis me'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i shar du badz+ra he ru ka lhor rat+na/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du karma he ru ka bzhis bskor ba bzhi po g.yas rang rtags dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa khro bo'i chas can/ lte bar che mchog thod phreng rtsal dmar nag khro tshul rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs pa g.yon phur pas dgra bgegs gzir ba rus pa'i rgyan drug dang thod phreng gsol ba stag lpags kyi gdan la phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ sku las khro chung dpag med spro zhing me'i dbus na gnas pa'i thugs kar ram̐ gyi steng du hūm̐ me 'bar ba/ des rang gzhan kun gyi log rtog sreg pa/ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa/ stong gsum hūm̐ sgras gang ba/ gsang ba'i sbu gu rdo rje sngon po rtse mo gsum pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi snying dbus chos 'byung bsnol ma ro'i steng na rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams pa sku mdog nag po/ spyi gtsug na phag zhal gyen lta spyan gsum mche gtsigs thod pa dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ shar du badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī/ lhor rat+na/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du karma bzhi gri thod/ lte ba na khros ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i lte ba āḥs mtshan pa/ yab yum gyi spyi gtsug tu bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang gu ru mtshan brgyad/ grub thob bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba ḍa ma ru dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams pa/

gar gyi nyams dang ldan par bsgom/ sngags ni thod phreng rtsal gyi sham bur/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ bā shaṃ mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ spro na thun gyi thog mtha' rnams su sngar gyi sngags sham du/ oṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ kro dha sid+dhi hūm̐/ hrīḥr tsa hri ya oṃ hūm̐ trūm̐ hrīḥ.āḥ/ shrī he ru ka sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kro dhī shwa rī sa ma ya dzaḥ baṃ ha ri ni sa badz+ra bhā ra hī hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes btags pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla ba'o// yang thod phreng rigs lnga bsgoms pa'i 'phro 'dus bzla na rtsa bar/ gsum pa phrin las dmigs pa ni/ bsnyen bsgrub gang la drod thob nas: phrin las sgrub pa'i 'phro 'du ni: bdag nyid thugs las 'od 'phros pas: zhi ba'i las byed thod phreng rtsal: zhes sogs gsungs pa/ rang thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i mdun dang phyogs bzhir thod phreng rigs lnga mdun du bud+dha thod phreng rtsal sku mdog smug po g.yas ḍa ma ru dang g.yon 'khor lo dang thod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i shar du rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dkar po g.yas ḍa ru g.yon rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ lhor rat+na thod phreng rtsal ser po g.yas ḍa ru g.yon rin po che dang zhags pa/ nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dmar po g.yas ḍa ru g.yon pad+ma dang lcags sgrog byang du karma thod phreng rtsal ljang gu g.yas ḍā ru g.yon rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa lnga po yum med sku mdog dang mthun pa'i na bza'/ zhabs rdor skyil pad zla la bzhugs pa/ rang rigs dang mthun pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba bskyed la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po hūm̐ gi rang bzhin can spros rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phog de'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag med spros/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung bar gcod thams cad zhi bar bsam/

de bzhin du 'od zer ser po swā'i rang bzhin can spros pas tshe bsod dbang thang thams cad rgyas par bsam/ 'od zer dmar po ām̐ gi rang bzhin spros khams gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdus nas bde chen gyi sa la bkod/ 'od zer ljang gu hā'i rang bzhin spros bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad nas bla med kyi gnas su bsgral/ 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan spros/ bud+dha thod phreng rtsal la phog de las spros pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad zil gyis mnan/ phrin las mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par bsam/ 'od zer spro tshul ni rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// sngags ni rtsa sngags kyi sham bur hrī ma sogs btags pa nyid yin cing*/ dmigs pa'i 'phro 'dus las kyi kha bsgyur shes na don thams cad 'grub par gsungs te/ 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa ma shes na: dmigs pa phyogs gcig don mi 'grub: 'di bzhin phrin las sbyor shes na: gang ltar bsam pa de ltar 'grub: dper na yid bzhin nor bu 'dra: rgyas par las tshogs bzhin du sbyar: zhes gsungs pas bsnyen sgrub rtags ldan sngon du song nas mkha' 'gro'i las brgyad sogs las tshogs gzhan rnams gang dgos skabs dang sbyar chog par bshad do// zhes pa'ang bi dza yas bris pa ste 'gal 'khrul mchis na mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par 'tshal lo// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ /bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir rtsa gsum kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che'i thugs sgrub thams cad kyi mthar thug pa bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i nyams len mdor bsdus pa'i rim pa la/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du:

bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas su: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca'o: lan gsum/ dngos gzhi lha bsgom pa ni/ oṃ/ chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sems: pad+ma rgyal po 'di skad smra: dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing : smra brjod bral ba rdzogs pa che: blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: āḥ blo bral de yi ngang nyid las: sems can kun la khyab pa yi: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom: hūm̐/ stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nyid las: 'gro don dpag med byed pa'i slad: rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje'i 'od las gzhal yas khang : pad+ma rin chen 'bar bar spel: 'ja' tshon bres pa lta bu'i nang : lte dbus nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : rdo rje gnas gyur dran rdzogs su: rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu yi gtsug: rta mgo rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: phyag g.yas dbang sdud gri gug 'phyar: phyag g.yon thod pa khrag bkang gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud bzhi brdzis: nyi zla pad steng 'gying zhing brjid: g.yon nas rdo rje phag mos 'khyud: cha lugs yab 'dra spyi bo'i gtsug: phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrogs: gzhon tshul nu ma bha ga rgyas: bskal pa'i me phung klong na bzhugs: 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: de nyid spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng : pad+ma ge sar snying po la: bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs can: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: de yi 'phang g.yon rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon tshul can: pad mdog nu ma bha ga rgyas: rin chen rus rgyan cod pan can:

phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: phyag g.yon thod pa'i bdud rtsi stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: sku mdog dkar dmar 'dzum mdangs can: skra grol gcer bu 'od ldan bsam: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i thod phreng rtsal: dkar ser dmar dang ljang gu'i mdog: las bzhi sgrub phyir mos pas bskyed: khor yug 'ja' yi drwa bar bsgom: phyogs mtshams rin chen zur brgyad kyi: 'dzum steng bar snang 'ja' 'od klong : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad gsal: hrīḥ pho brang phyogs bzhir pad 'dab bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen 'bru'i: nang khongs zhing gi gdan bzhi la: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: sku mdog rigs kyi kha dog la: 'khril sbyor rgyan dang cha lugs rnams: gtso bo yab yum gnyis ltar bskyed: sna tshogs pad 'khor phyi ma la: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin dang : rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: dngos grub ster zhing bar chad sel: glu dang gar byed rol mo sgrog: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs stob: char sprin gtibs pa lta bur bskyed: du mar snang yang rang du gcig: bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: zhes pa'i dgongs pa srog tu bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la sems rtse gcig pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ kye kye bla ma rin po che: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zung : bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' che: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig po: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: sdug bsngal 'dam nas drang du gsol: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzod:

bdag la dbang bskur byin rlobs la: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun: 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla zhing*/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te/ bla ma yab yum sku yi gnas bzhi nas: 'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas bzhir thim: sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis: byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes bzlas mthar thod phreng rtsal rang la thim pas rang thod phreng rtsal gyi skur gyur pa'i nga rgyal dang bcas te sems rtse gcig pas kyang bzla ba dang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs bzhi'i thod phreng bskul bas sku dang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus phrin las gang 'dod bsgrubs par bsams la/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥsarba sid+dhi shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ bā shaṃ mā ra ya rbad: ces pa'ang cung zad bzla'o// thun mthar nyer bsdu ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid: dgyes pa chen pos rang la thim: rang yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i: ngang la yid ni 'dzin pa bral: rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku: zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad spyi bo'i bla ma la 'dus shing*/ de nyid rang la bstims nas gnyis med spros bral blo 'das kyi dgongs pa bskyang ngo*// bsngo smon ni/ e ma ho: bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: bskal pa dpag med tshun chad nas: tha ma da ltar thug gi bar: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bla ma skyes mchog yi dam lha: sangs rgyas byang sems ḍā ki'i tshogs: bsgoms bsgrubs mchod cing bstod pa dang : bris bklags bcangs shing kun chub bgyis: lta dgongs la sogs dge spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur nas: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi:

bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs shing : dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i: 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun: bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: ces dang*/ shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don 'grub pa'i: don grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga nas: phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog: ces shis brjod kyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug go /zhes pa'ang rang gzhan rnams kyis rgyun gyi rnal 'byor khyer bde ba'i phyir gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi rgyal po gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis lho brag gnam skas can nas spyan drangs pa'i gter gzhung rtsa ba las ngag 'don snying por dril ba 'di yang*/ rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa mañdzu gho ṣas sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /'di'i sgo nas tshe sgrub dmigs bsal byed na 'phyang drug gi nang tshan tshe sgrub kyi 'phyang nyams su blang ste/ de yang las sbyor gyi bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bla ma mgon po tshe dpag med kyi ngo bo/ o rgyan pad+ma sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ gu ru a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phyi nang gi mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐/ ā yu ṣe sa ra he ka ra re shud+dhe āḥ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ rang gi snying gar tshe'i dwangs ma a dkar po gcig bsam/ rlung sna bug g.yon nas drangs pas bum pa'i bdud rtsi dkar nar gyis sna bug g.yon nas byung khong pa'i nang du song bas lus thams cad gang*/

'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes bzla/ rlung phyir 'byin pa'i tshe nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad ba spu'i bu ga nas thon par bsam/ mthar/ mdun gyi gu ru nyid rang gi snying ga'i āḥl thim pas rdo rje'i srog 'grub par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la nyer bsdu sogs dkyus bzhin no// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
